استهلكتما (form X)
# اِسْتَهْلَكْتُمَا (istahlaktumā) /is.tah.lak.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اُسْتُهْلِكْتُمَا (ustuhliktumā) /us.tuh.lik.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
